texts.https://cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-10:
Ivanti Connect Secure: Authentication bypass by spoofing in ICS before version 25.1.3.0 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands
Authentication bypass by spoofing in ICS before version 25.1.3.0 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. This does not impact ICS version 22.7R2.14 or prior. CVSS 3.1 8.6 (cna). CISA SSVC: exploitation active, automatable yes, technical impact total. CISA KEV: added 2026-10-13.
texts.https://cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-96:
Windows Shell Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
Improper neutralization of special elements used in a command ('command injection') in Windows Shell allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network. CVSS 3.1 8.8 (cna).
texts.https://cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-10:
Edimax BR-6208AC formAutoFWupgrade command injection
A vulnerability was determined in Edimax BR-6208AC 1.32 that can lead to command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been publicly disclosed. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. CVSS 3.1 10.0 (cna). CISA SSVC: exploitation poc, automatable yes, technical impact total.
texts.https://cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-11:
Device-mapper-persistent-data: device-mapper-persistent-data: denial of service via crafted block indices
A flaw was found in device-mapper-persistent-data. A local attacker can cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by inducing a user or system tool to process crafted device metadata containing an excessively large block index. An arithmetic error in the synchronous block reading logic causes the application to panic and unexpectedly terminate. CVSS 3.1 3.3 (cna). Credits: This issue was discovered by Found by AISLE in partnership with Red Hat.
texts.https://ivanti.com/ct-sample/connect-sec:
SAMPLE: Security Advisory: Ivanti Connect Secure (CVE-2026-104935)
SAMPLE advisory text. Ivanti is aware of a limited number of customers whose Connect Secure appliances have been exploited through CVE-2026-104935, an authentication bypass by spoofing that lets a remote unauthenticated attacker execute arbitrary commands. Connect Secure 25.1.3.0 fixes the issue and is available now. Version 22.7R2.14 and earlier are not affected.

texts.https://teamt5.org/ct-sample/paper-kestr:
SAMPLE: Paper Kestrel targets Taiwan's semiconductor equipment makers
SAMPLE report. TeamT5 assesses with moderate confidence that Paper Kestrel, a China-nexus threat group, has targeted at least 12 Taiwanese semiconductor equipment makers since September 2026. The group sends fake supplier invoices that carry a remote access tool.
texts.https://theregister.com/ct-sample/red-ha:
SAMPLE: Red Hat keeps crediting an AI bug hunter
SAMPLE article. Red Hat has credited AISLE, an AI vulnerability-finding system, with 24 flaws in its Linux packages since 1 October. Red Hat rated none of them critical: the highest scores 7.5, and the newest, published on 13 October, is a low-severity local crash bug scored 3.3. Most are local bugs that need a user to open a crafted file.
